changeinfo.changes:
changes:
  • Rendering artifacts have been fixed on PS4 and PS Vita.
  • Transition effect artifact removed.
  • Movement on the Overworld is now smoother.
  • Camera movement in-game is now smoother.
  • Using the main menu with an analog stick no longer causes audio issue.
  • The credits sequence can now be skipped.
  • Transitioning into game from boot is now smoother on PS4 and PS Vita.
  • Stability improvements made to boss rooms.
